home.headline: Twubaka ejo hazaza
home.sub: AYA Informatica RW ikora kandi ishyiraho imbuga zinoze zigabanya ubucuruzi, zongera ubufatanye bw'abantu, kandi zihanamura amahirwe y'ubukungu mu mugabane wose.
home.pillarsDesc: Dukora aho ubucuruzi, ikoranabuhanga, n'uburambe bw'abantu bihuza — twubaka sisitemu zigenewe gukura hamwe n'Afrika.
home.approachDesc: Buri gicuruzwa dushyiraho gikurikiza filosofi y'umurimo — cyubatswe ku bantu nyabo, cyubatswe kugira ngo gikure, kandi gishingiye ku kwizera.
home.ctaDesc: Fataanya na AYA Informatica RW kugira ngo mwubake ibikorwa remezo bya numerike Afrika ikeneye.
home.metaTitle: AYA Informatica RW – Twubaka ejo hazaza h'ikoranabuhanga rya Afrika
home.metaDescription: AYA Informatica RW ishushanya kandi ishyiraho imbuga nshya zoroshya ubucuruzi, zongera ubufatanye bw'abantu, kandi zigatanga amahirwe y'ubukungu muri Afrika.

footer.tagline: Twubaka ejo hazaza h'ikoranabuhanga rya Afrika uhereye i Kigali, Rwanda.

contact.headline: Twubake
contact.sub: Niba ushaka gufatanya, kubona ibicuruzwa byacu hakiri kare, cyangwa gusa kumenya byinshi — twishimiye kukwakira.
contact.basedIn: Tubarizwa i Kigali, Rwanda — kandi twubakira Afrika yose. Twandikire dutangire ikiganiro.
contact.subject: Insanganyamatsiko
contact.networkErrorDesc: Reba imiyoboro yawe cyangwa utwandikire kuri imeli.
contact.metaDescription: Twandikire muri AYA Informatica RW. Dufatanye, ubone RAY hakiri kare, cyangwa uganire ku mushinga.
contact.ogTitle: Twandikire AYA Informatica RW – Twubake hamwe
contact.ogDescription: Dufatanye, ubone RAY hakiri kare, ubaze kuri serivisi, cyangwa urebe amahirwe yo gushora imari.
contact.twitterDescription: Dufatanye cyangwa utwandikire ku bicuruzwa na serivisi zacu.

common.errorDesc: Ikosa ritateganijwe ryabaye. Ushobora kugerageza nanone cyangwa gusubira ku rupapuro rw'itangiriro.

ray.name: RAY
ray.tagline: Isoko rya mbere kuri telefoni mu Rwanda ryo kugura no kugurisha.
ray.description: RAY ni isoko ryubatswe ryibanda kuri telefoni, ryagenewe koroshya kugura no kugurisha mu Rwanda, hatangirwa kuri telefoni n'ibikoresho by'ikoranabuhanga. Ryubakiye ku kwizerana, umuvuduko, no kuboneka — RAY rihuza abaguzi n'abagurisha ku buryo butaziguye kandi bugaragara.
features: Hura ku buryo butaziguye n'abaguzi cyangwa abagurisha
Gera ku isoko rigari kandi rikora cyane

humura.name: Humura
humura.tagline: Ubuzima bwo mu mutwe n'ubufasha mu marangamutima — kuri Afrika.
humura.description: Humura ni urubuga rwa numerike rwibanda ku buzima bwo mu mutwe no ku bufasha mu marangamutima. Rutanga uburyo bwizewe kandi butamenyekana bwo kubona ubufasha, uburambe bwibanda ku muntu, n'ahantu ha numerike hizewe ku buzima bwiza bwa buri muntu.
features: Uburyo bwizewe kandi butamenyekana bwo kubona ubufasha
Igishushanyo cya UX cyibanda ku muntu
Kwibanda ku buzima bwiza bwa buri muntu

platform.title: Kubaka imbuga
platform.tagline: Imbuga za numerike zuzuye zubatswe kugira ngo zikure.
platform.description: Dushushanya kandi twubaka imbuga za numerike zishobora gukura uhereye ku ntangiriro. Waba ukeneye isoko, urutonde rwa serivisi, cyangwa urubuga rw'ubucuruzi — turubaka kugira ngo rwizerwe, rukore neza, kandi rukure igihe kirekire.
capabilities: Gushushanya API n'ibikorwa remezo bya backend
Ibikorwa remezo bya cloud na DevOps

intelligent.title: Sisitemu z'ubwenge
intelligent.tagline: Sisitemu zishingiye ku makuru zifata ibyemezo byiza.
intelligent.description: Dushushanya sisitemu zikoresha amakuru n'ikoranabuhanga rigezweho kugira ngo zongere imikorere, gufata ibyemezo, n'uburambe bw'abakoresha — kuva kuri sisitemu z'inama kugeza ku mbonerahamwe z'isesengura.
capabilities: Gukora ibikorwa mu buryo bwikora n'ibikoresho by'imirimo

solutions.title: Ibisubizo bya numerike
solutions.tagline: Porogaramu zihariye ku bigo byiteguye kuvugurura.
solutions.description: Dutanga ibisubizo bya porogaramu byihariye ku bigo bishaka kwinjira muri numerike, koroshya, no kwagura ibikorwa byabyo. Porogaramu zifite intego — atari ibikoresho rusange.
capabilities: Gukora porogaramu za web na telefoni
